intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both sit in {{cityA}}, and this page compares their recorded {{course}} fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
Mithibai College vs SK Somaiya College is not a single winner. Compare fees, admission tests and the BCom classroom each campus offers.

sections.heading: Mithibai College vs SK Somaiya College for BCom: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Mithibai College if you want a recorded fee of ₹5,545, in a private BCom setting at Mumbai.
Choose SK Somaiya College if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹3 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹16,100, in a private BCom setting at Mumbai.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.
Our records show ₹5,545 as a programme total for Bachelor of Commerce(B.Com.) at Mithibai College.

Our records show ₹16,100 as a tuition figure for B.Com Banking & Insurance at SK Somaiya College. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for Mithibai College here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.

SK Somaiya College's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹3 LPA and a highest package of ₹4 LPA on B.Com Banking & Insurance. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for Mithibai College on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.
Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for SK Somaiya College on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Maharashtra. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether Mithibai College's recorded ₹5,545 or SK Somaiya College's ₹16,100 fits your budget for this BCom.
If you want a documented flagship placement year, SK Somaiya College is the clearer record here, because Mithibai College has no 2020-or-later flagship package on this page.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Mithibai College or SK Somaiya College?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. Mithibai College and SK Somaiya College differ in more than one way: the useful differences are fees, the admission test and the kind of BCom classroom each campus offers.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for Mithibai College vs SK Somaiya College?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹5,545 for Mithibai College on Bachelor of Commerce(B.Com.); our records list ₹16,100 for SK Somaiya College on B.Com Banking & Insurance. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for Mithibai College and SK Somaiya College?
faqs.answer: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for Mithibai College here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do Mithibai College and SK Somaiya College accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list no listed exam on this page for Mithibai College, and no listed exam on this page for SK Somaiya College. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are Mithibai College and SK Somaiya College in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Mumbai, Maharashtra. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
